en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3328 - It is narrated from Uthman ibn Isa, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (as). I said to Imam (as), "A man from my brothers has a testimony with me, but not all of it is admissible by the judges here."
Imam (as) said: "If you know that it is true, then validate it in every possible way so that his right is established."
